description: This header file declares internal API functions related to upload diagnostics in the Broadband Home Manager Model (BBHM). It provides function prototypes for managing upload diagnostics operations such as engaging, canceling, starting/stopping diagnostics, and configuring settings.

methods.name: BbhmUploadEngage
methods.description: Engages or initializes the upload diagnostic process.

methods.name: BbhmUploadCancel
methods.description: Cancels or aborts the ongoing upload diagnostic process.

methods.name: BbhmUploadSetupEnv
methods.description: Sets up the environment needed for upload diagnostics.

methods.name: BbhmUploadCloseEnv
methods.description: Closes or cleans up the upload diagnostics environment.

methods.name: BbhmUploadStopDiag
methods.description: Stops the ongoing upload diagnostic operation.

methods.name: BbhmUploadGetResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result handle of the upload diagnostics.

methods.name: BbhmUploadGetConfig
methods.description: Obtains the current configuration of the upload diagnostic process.

methods.name: BbhmUploadSetConfig
methods.description: Sets the configuration parameters for upload diagnostics.

methods.name: BbhmUploadSetDiagState
methods.description: Sets the state of the upload diagnostic process, such as starting, stopping, or other states.
